value.rationale: The 4x4 square is the smallest genuinely spatial (non-complete) square torus with eight distinct Moore neighbors. At the threshold-four equality boundary, the 2026 source reports only high empirical fixation and the known strict-majority theorem is inapplicable. The exact all-state global fixation result, sharp ten-step cutoff and exact count of absorbing states are a natural complete finite classification and rigorous benchmark for the open broad-scale fixation problem; no broader dynamics are claimed.
